events.summary: Patch correctly guards coupon None/missing in compute_total and adds missing ownership check to read_order, matching the existing pattern in read_order_total. Both fixes address root causes directly, not just test symptoms, and all previously failing tests now pass without regressions.

hypotheses.note: Error log, code line 101, synthetic data (order 9 coupon None), live reproduction as bob ->500, and test_total_without_coupon failure directly prove None subscript crash; patch fixes with or {} and .get(percent,0).

Code comparison shows read_order lacked check present in total endpoint, reproduction GET /orders/7 as bob returned 200 for owner_id 1, and test_user_cannot_read_someone_elses_order failed as expected.

risks: compute_total still assumes items/price/qty well-formed and percent numeric; non-numeric or percent=None would still raise 500, but out of scope for reported incident
No validation of percent range (>100/negative) allowing anomalous totals, not blocking for this fix

report.incident:
Two reports came in for the orders_api service:
1. Users say GET /orders/9/total sometimes returns 500.
2. A security reviewer suspects users can see other users' orders.

Test credentials for the sandbox: 'token-alice' (user 1) and 'token-bob' (user 2), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

hypotheses.claim: GET /orders/9/total 500 due to missing coupon handling (None subscript)
hypotheses.next_check: Read app.py and logs, reproduce request
evidence: ERROR log r-105 GET /orders/9/total TypeError NoneType not subscriptable traceback app.py:101
hypotheses.reason: Coupon=None crashes subscript at compute_total line 101, proven by logs and reproduction

hypotheses.claim: Order read endpoints lack ownership check allowing cross-user access
hypotheses.symptom: users can see other users' orders
hypotheses.next_check: Read app.py auth logic and reproduce cross-user request
evidence: orders_api/app.py:93-96 read_order returns any order with no owner check vs app.py:108-109 total endpoint has check
reproduced GET /orders/7 as token-bob (user 2) -> 200 returning owner_id 1 order
hypotheses.reason: read_order missing ownership check allows cross-user read, proven by reproduction

evidence: ERROR log r-105 GET /orders/9/total TypeError NoneType not subscriptable traceback app.py:101
issues.fix: In compute_total guard coupon None/missing: coupon = order.get("coupon") or {}; discount = subtotal * coupon.get("percent", 0) / 100
issues.root_cause: compute_total at app.py:101 does discount=subtotal*order["coupon"]["percent"]/100 with no None guard, crashing with TypeError NoneType not subscriptable when order 9 has coupon None
issues.title: GET /orders/9/total 500 due to missing coupon handling (None subscript)

evidence: orders_api/app.py:93-96 read_order returns any order with no owner check vs app.py:108-109 total endpoint has check
reproduced GET /orders/7 as token-bob (user 2) -> 200 returning owner_id 1 order
issues.fix: In read_order add missing ownership check: if order["owner_id"] != user["id"]: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="order not found")
issues.root_cause: read_order returns any order with no owner check, unlike total endpoint which has check, allowing cross-user access
issues.title: Order read endpoints lack ownership check allowing cross-user access

findings.summary: Investigation confirmed two issues in orders_api: intermittent 500 on GET /orders/9/total and cross-user order visibility. Both root causes fixed per patch and verified with tests/test_orders.py::test_total_without_coupon and test_user_cannot_read_someone_elses_order passing, no regressions, independent review approve.
